name: Apprenticeship — Legacy Events: Same Learner/Course/Provider, Repeated Under Different Employers
description: Reproduction attempt for a prod defect: some approved ApprenticeshipEpisode rows have ApprovalsApprenticeshipId = 0. Reported affected rows are 'continuations' — a learner repeatedly approved onto the same course, same provider, but under a different employer each time (ChangeOfEmployer/continuation in Commitments). This story simulates three legacy ApprenticeshipCreatedEvents arriving one after another for the same ULN/TrainingCode/UKPRN, each with a different AccountId (employer), ApprenticeshipId, and ContinuationOfId pointing at the previous one — with no SLD draft POST involved at all (draft-POST/FLP-1537 stays out of scope). No code bug has been found by static tracing in AddLearningCommandHandler/ApprenticeshipEpisodeDomainModel.Approve — every write path there uses the real incoming ApprenticeshipId. This story exists to either confirm that (all three episodes land with their own correct, non-zero ApprovalsApprenticeshipId) or disprove it (something lands at 0), before concluding the prod data issue is historical/migration-only rather than a live code bug.

steps.name: Commitments approves the original apprenticeship (Employer A, ApprenticeshipId 300001)
Commitments approves a continuation onto the same course/provider (Employer B, ApprenticeshipId 300002, ContinuationOfId 300001)
Commitments approves a second continuation onto the same course/provider (Employer C, ApprenticeshipId 300003, ContinuationOfId 300002)

assertions.name: Three independent ApprenticeshipLearning rows exist for the learner (no dedicated Repeat/Continuation handling — each event creates its own row)
Each episode's ApprovalsApprenticeshipId matches the real incoming event value for its employer — none should be 0
